content_sections.heading: ICSSR Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ICSSR Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ICSSR Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ICSSR Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Assistant and 4 for Field Investigator.

content_sections.heading: ICSSR Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Post graduate in Social Science discipline with minimum 55% with NET/ M.Phil/ Ph.D. Field Investigator: Post Graduate in Social Science discipline with minimum 55% marks

content_sections.heading: ICSSR Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Rs.37,000/ - p.m Field Investigator: Rs.20,000/ - p.m

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICSSR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 02-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICSSR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICSSR Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts is 02 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ICSSR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Research Assistant and Field Investigator positions in the Indian Council of Social Science Research.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Field Investigator?
faq.answer: For the Field Investigator position, candidates must have a Post Graduate degree in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for a Research Assistant at ICSSR?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for ICSSR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these ICSSR posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant and Field Investigator roles will involve shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for the ICSSR vacancies?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents via email before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Research Assistant and Field Investigator at ICSSR are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ICSSR located?
faq.answer: The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) is located in Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. What is the minimum percentage required in Post Graduation for Field Investigator?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have secured a minimum of 55% marks in their Post Graduation in a Social Science discipline to be eligible for the Field Investigator role.
